title: Implement tax calculation from taxRateId
description: Compute taxAmount per item using tax_rates inclusive/exclusive rate instead of hardcoded 0n
completion: Implemented tax calculation from taxRateId: created lib/server/tax.ts with parseRateToBps, exclusiveTax, inclusiveTax helpers. Checkout now loads tax rates, computes per-item tax (inclusive/exclusive), stores item-level taxAmount, and correctly calculates order total (subtotal - item discounts - order discount + service charge + exclusive tax). Fixed pre-existing bug where item discounts were not subtracted from order total. Added 3 unit tests for tax math.
